about_the_game:
Plunder Protocol is a unique blend of RTS, MOBA, Auto Battler, and Tower Defense, designed for players who love strategy but hate micro-management. Build your forces, adapt your tactics, and outplay your opponents with smart decisions instead of fast clicks. Every match is a battle of strategy, not mechanics.

Playtest

We've decided to go with an open playtest, just click the button and you will automatically receive access to the playtest.

The game is currently in a prototype stage, it's not a complete or finished product. You will run into annoying bugs.

Plunder Protocol currently requires 2 players to play, there's a quick play feature, but not a lot of players yet, so join our Discord if you're looking for someone to play against or if you have any questions or want to provide feedback.

About The Game

Build your base, recruit units to steal resources from the enemy team, protect your own resources by building towers.

Choose from several buildings, each with unique upgrades. They will spawn your units. Units automatically move across the map to steal resources and fight your enemies.

Choose from several towers with unique strengths and weaknesses to defend your own resources and your base.

Hide in the jungle, where you can claim bonus resources by defeating neutral monsters and then sneak up on your opponent with a flank attack.

Win the game by destroying your opponent's base.

Discord

Join our Discord server to participate in early alpha testing. You can find a link in the sidebar here on the store page.
